entities.name: The Mirari
entities.description: An artifact of unspeakable power that grants its wielder's desires but brings disaster and death, created by Karn as a probe and later reshaped into Memnarch.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The land where the Mirari appears and causes cycles of warfare and disaster.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The creator of the Mirari, who retrieves it, reshapes it as Memnarch and takes Jeska as an apprentice.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A golem created by Karn from the Mirari as protector of Argentum, who renames the plane Mirrodin.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A cabalist who first finds the Mirari, resists it, later uses it to overthrow the Patriarch and dies overwhelmed by his own spell.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: The organization led by the First and then the Patriarch, centered on Cabal City.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: The Cabal's leader who returns the Mirari to Chainer and is exiled to Aphetto.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A barbarian who becomes obsessed with the Mirari, wounds his sister Jeska, kills Laquatus and tries to slay Karona.

entities.name: Kirtar
entities.description: A lieutenant of the Order who claims the Mirari, uses it to kill Pianna and dies when his spell destroys the citadel.

entities.name: The Order
entities.description: An organization whose citadel is devastated by Kirtar's spell.

entities.name: Pianna
entities.description: The human leader of the Order on Otaria, killed by Kirtar with the Mirari.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A merman fixated on the Mirari who makes a deal with cabalists and is killed by Kamahl.

entities.name: Turg
entities.description: Laquatus's minion who recovers the Mirari and gives it to Captain Satas.

entities.name: Captain Satas
entities.description: A captain who takes the Mirari to Emperor Aboshan.

entities.name: Emperor Aboshan
entities.description: The Mer Empire's emperor who floods northern Otaria with the Mirari and dies in the disaster.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A cabalist who resists the Mirari and returns it to the Patriarch.

entities.name: Burke
entities.description: A champion created for Laquatus using the Mirari.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, mortally wounded by him, who is freed when Karona dies and becomes a planeswalker and Karn's apprentice.

entities.name: Balthor
entities.description: Kamahl's mentor whose ghost later guides him.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A being killed when her minions Sash and Waistcoat drive a blade through her back.

entities.name: Sash
entities.description: A minion of Karona who betrays her.

entities.name: Waistcoat
entities.description: A minion of Karona who betrays her.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: The land where the Mirari-sword is left in the ground and mutating energy spreads from.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Karn's artificial plane, renamed by Memnarch.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A guardian left in charge of the Mirari on Mirrodin.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: A guardian left in charge of the Mirari on Mirrodin.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: A guardian left in charge of the Mirari on Mirrodin.

events.summary: Chainer finds the Mirari in an old mansion and gives it to the First as a tournament prize.
events.quote: The Mirari was found by Chainer in an old mansion

events.summary: Kirtar claims the Mirari to destroy it but is corrupted and uses it to kill Pianna.
events.quote: Instead, he took it to the Order's citadel and used it to kill Pianna

events.summary: Kirtar's uncontrolled spell devastates the citadel and kills him.
events.quote: Kirtar was unable to end his spell, which went on to devastate the citadel and kill the Lieutenant.

events.summary: Turg gives the Mirari to Captain Satas, who takes it to Emperor Aboshan.
events.quote: Turg gave the Mirari to Captain Satas

events.summary: Aboshan pours mana into the Mirari, flooding the northern third of Otaria; the spell destroys the capital and kills him.
events.quote: He poured mana into the Mirari to try to make the vision a reality, creating a massive wave that flooded the northern third of Otaria.

events.summary: Braids takes the Mirari back to the Patriarch.
events.quote: fell into the hands of Braids

events.summary: Chainer uses the Mirari to heal Kamahl and then to overthrow the Patriarch and exile him to Aphetto.
events.quote: he used it to overthrow the Cabal Patriarch and exile him to Aphetto

events.summary: Chainer is overloaded by the Mirari in a battle with Kamahl, unleashing dementia horrors, and dies.
events.quote: he was overwhelmed by his own spell and died.

events.summary: Kamahl attaches the Mirari to his sword and tries to unite the Pardic barbarians by force.
events.quote: He attached it to the pommel of his sword and tried to use its power to unite the Pardic barbarians under his rule.

events.summary: Kamahl mortally wounds his sister Jeska with the Mirari-enhanced sword.
events.quote: he used his Mirari-enhanced sword to mortally wound Jeska

events.summary: Kamahl kills Laquatus in Krosa and leaves the Mirari-sword in the ground.
events.quote: Kamahl finishing the merman by driving the Mirari-sword through Laquatus and into the ground

events.summary: The Mirari pours energy into Krosa, mutating creatures and plants across Otaria.
events.quote: the Mirari now began pouring energy into Krosa

events.summary: Karona is betrayed and killed by her minions Sash and Waistcoat, releasing Jeska, who becomes a planeswalker.
events.quote: killing Karona and releasing Jeska, who then became a planeswalker.

events.summary: Karn reveals the Mirari's origins and takes it back to Argentum.
events.quote: Karn appeared and revealed the Mirari's humble origins and took it back to Argentum

events.summary: Karn reshapes the Mirari into the sentient Memnarch, protector of Argentum.
events.quote: Karn reshaped the Mirari as a sentient being

events.summary: After Memnarch's defeat Karn melts him down, revealing the Mirari, left in the care of Glissa, Slobad and Geth.
events.quote: Karn returned to his plane and melted down Memnarch to his core, revealing the Mirari underneath.

relations.note: He reshaped the Mirari into Memnarch.
relations.quote: Karn reshaped the Mirari as a sentient being
Kamahl finishing the merman by driving the Mirari-sword through Laquatus

relations.note: Uses the Mirari to kill her.

relations.quote: Karona was ultimately betrayed by her own minions

relations.note: Friends who fight under the Mirari's influence.
relations.quote: In a battle with his friend, Kamahl
Turg gave the Mirari to Captain Satas
